notes: `רָאשֵׁי הָאָבוֹת` → *the heads of the fathers houses* follows rule 31's own worked example: *of fathers houses* goes to `אָב`, headed on *fathers*, with the supplied head noun joining the written noun's unit.
Two *the*s are written for one article morpheme, so the article takes the one standing before its own word and the construct takes a supplied one (rule 29).
Variant unit WLC.1CH.23.9.v001 was decided upstream and is honoured as projected (rule 9).
